The Whiteriver Indian Health Service (WRSU) Hospital and Special Service Building (SSB) requires a contracting action for the procurement of annual ventilation assessment services to include Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning (HVAC) system Testing and Balancing (TAB). The scope of work detailed below outlines the required project outcomes. The Contractor shall be responsible for
all necessary work to achieve required outcomes including labor, equipment, tools, personal protective equipment (PPE), policy adherence, infection control compliance, incidental design, travel, per diem, tribal fees, and other related expenses required to complete the project.
